name: Marshall Major IV 4 Wireless Bluetooth Headphones Classic Earphones Deep Bass Foldable Pop Rock Retro Music Microphone Headset Master Copy
description:
Marshall Major IV Wireless Bluetooth Headphones
Product Overview

The Marshall Major IV delivers the iconic Marshall sound with powerful bass, crisp mids, and smooth highs. Designed for true music lovers, this stylish foldable headset combines retro aesthetics with modern wireless performance, making it perfect for pop, rock, and everyday use.

Key Features

Brand: Marshall

Model: Major IV

Origin: Mainland China

Certification: CE Certified

Audio & Performance

Sound Mode: 3D Surround Sound Mode

Audio Crossover: Full-range for balanced sound

Bass: Deep, dynamic bass for immersive listening

Voice Control: Supported

Microphone: Built-in mic for clear hands-free calling

Design & Build

Type: Over-ear foldable headphones

Material: Premium leather finish with soft cushioned ear pads

Style: Classic Marshall retro design

Portability: Foldable and lightweight for easy carrying

Connectivity & Compatibility

Communication: Wireless Bluetooth

Input/Output: AUX port for wired use

Channels: 2 (Stereo 2.0)

Compatibility: Works with Android, iOS, PC, and any Bluetooth-enabled device

Battery & Power

Power Source: Built-in rechargeable battery

Battery: Long-lasting playback time

Charging Type: USB (fast charging supported)

Input Power: 200–299W

Additional Features

Waterproof: Yes (splash resistant)

App Support: No

Smart Assistant: None required — simple plug-and-play design

Harmful Chemicals: None

Package Includes

1 × Marshall Major IV Wireless Headphones

1 × AUX Cable

1 × Charging Cable

1 × User Manual
